# Copper CRM | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Management of sales within Gmail | The main link, “List or interactive entry - formation of a customer and business - push phase - triggers the next step - manage the double drive”, is used to verify whether management sales within Gmail actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Conveyment of consultancy/agent projects | The main link, “List or interactive entry - formation of customer and business opportunities - advance phase - triggers the next step - manage the double disk”, is used to verify whether the interface between consultancy/agent projects actually reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Clients nurture mail | Using “lists or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - advance phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - managing the double drive, to verify whether customer nurturing mail really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Google Eco-Small CRM | The main link, “List or interactive entry - formation of customers and business opportunities - push phase - triggers the next step - manage the double drive”, is to verify whether Google’s ecological small business CRM actually reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
